report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with persistent fatigue for 2 months, daily headaches for 1 week, and increased thirst. They have been on Triumeq for 3 years with adherence issues - missing doses 2-3 times per week and occasionally taking drug holidays when feeling 'well.' Their HIV viral load was undetectable 6 months ago. They express concerns about long-term side effects and drug resistance, and occasionally wonder if doctors prescribe medications too readily. They trust the clinician's judgment.
